description: §52.8/§17.2 — the clean control for the if-enclosure fallback: the SAME server-authority <each>, wrapped in `show=` instead of `if=`, KEEPS its SSR first-paint render and fires no I-SSR-EACH-CLIENT-RENDERED. `show=` hides live DOM (a display toggle, §17.2); the subtree IS in the document tree at first paint, so the server-rendered rows paint.
rationale: g-ssr-each-under-if-blank-paint (S433). The discriminator is the LOWERING, not 'the element carries a conditional attribute': `if=` REMOVES (inert `<template>` + mount marker, §17.1) and `show=` HIDES (display toggle over live DOM, §17.2). A fix keyed on 'a conditional attribute' would silently delete the SSR first paint from every `show=`-guarded server list — this case fails if that happens.
